messages:
sanjay: Quick sync - CloudVista requested a compact marketplace-ready reference architecture, Terraform module, and a tiny sample app. GA in ~3 weeks. Who can own module, sample app, CI/publish flow, and security checklist?

anya: I can own the Terraform module and variable schema. Need security input on KMS and network constraints.

kate: I9ll take the sample app and README. Should we ship a container image or repo + deploy script?

mike: Container image + one-click deploy template. Marketplace likes images. Also add ARM (Ampere) builds.

sanjay: Partner called out Ampere SKUs. @cloud_partner_bot please ping CloudVista for registry & image perms.

cloud_partner_bot: Ping sent to @Elaine (CloudVista) - awaiting confirmation. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Module API should be minimal: vpc, subnets, secgroups, autoscaling/instance profile for inference, IAM role for model fetch. Expose outputs: endpoint_url, alb_dns, subnets.

anya: Draft usage snippet: 
```
module "cloudvista_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/cloudvista-inference-module"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  model_repo = "cloudvista/gpt-serve"
}
```

kate: Sample app should show two modes: 1) private (call local endpoint) and 2) hosted fallback (call Redwood API). Tiny Node example + curl.

mike: I'll add multi-arch build matrix in CI and Dockerfile notes for quantized runtimes. Recommend Ampere m6a, and g5 for GPU option.

sanjay: Proposed timeline: week0 scaffold+CI; week1 sample+multi-arch builds; week2 partner review+security audit; week3 finalize marketplace package+SBOM. Volunteers? @anya @kate

anya: Module scaffold ready by Tue.

kate: Sample app prototype by Thu.

mike: CI multi-arch builders + publish workflow by Wed.

oliver: Security checklist & KMS notes by Fri.

cloud_partner_bot: Marketplace package checklist: signed SBOM, minimal e2e smoke test, CLA for sample code. Issue #682 created in marketplace repo.

sanjay: Next sync Friday 10am PT. If CloudVista confirms registry perms earlier we can accelerate. :rocket:

Elaine (CloudVista): Confirmed registry perms via DM. I'll upload partner constraints doc to shared drive and tag thread when live.

mike: Once registry + constraints are live I'll push staging images and share digests.

anya: Opening module repo now and will add CHANGELOG + semver policy to match marketplace rules.

kate: Starting README sections: quickstart, deploy (container + terraform), local dev, troubleshooting.

oliver: Note: include a tiny smoke test that hits health endpoint and a sample inference request - satisfies marketplace e2e.

cloud_partner_bot: Reminder set for Fri 09:50 PT. :bell:

sanjay: I'll create a project board with milestones after this message. If blocked tag infra-eng with `marketplace-onramp`.
